# eval-report-html

> Python package `trysac-eval-report-html`, import name `eval_report_html`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies. Generates one self-contained, script-free static HTML report from evaluation result JSON files, with per-run tables and SVG trend lines.
